name: Art Reference Board: Mica
subtitle: Collect references, study them, and design on one infinite canvas — on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro.
description:
Your references should stay as close as your next brushstroke.

Mica is an art reference board built for illustrators, painters, animators, concept artists, character designers, tattoo artists, art students, and anyone who thinks visually. Gather images, photos, GIFs, WebP animations, video, and PDFs on a Metal-powered infinite canvas. Then study color, value, shape, pose, and motion without breaking your creative flow.

BUILD THE BOARD YOUR ART NEEDS
• Import from Photos, Files, folders, camera, document scanner, or clipboard
• Drag and drop on iPad and Mac
• Save references from other apps with the system share sheet
• Send new ideas to Capture Inbox and organize them later
• Reuse original images from your asset library across multiple boards

STUDY—DON’T JUST COLLECT
• Generate six- or twelve-color palettes from the dominant colors in your references
• Combine grayscale with two-, three-, four-, or six-level posterization for value studies
• Crop, flip, rotate, resize, and adjust opacity
• Play GIF and WebP animation, inspect timelines, and step frame by frame
• Step precisely through video and save useful frames to your canvas
• Run timed reference studies with interval and shuffle controls
• Annotate, highlight, measure, and sketch with Apple Pencil

KEEP REFERENCES BESIDE YOUR WORK
• Work beside your drawing or painting app on iPad
• Float a reference with Picture in Picture on iPhone and iPad
• Keep an always-on-top reference window on Mac
• Enter focus or presentation mode when you want the interface to disappear

ORGANIZE SERIOUS CREATIVE PROJECTS
• Build boards with pages and layers
• Arrange references in rows, columns, or a masonry-style grid
• Group, lock, hide, duplicate, snap, and reorder canvas items
• Add folders, tags, notes, sticky notes, styled text, and saved canvas regions
• Search reusable assets by name or tag, filter by dominant color, and find boards with Spotlight
• Keep favorites, recent work, reusable assets, and captured ideas within reach

PRIVATE, PORTABLE, AND YOURS
• Work offline by default
• Protect private boards and folders with a passcode or supported biometrics
• Restore an earlier local board version without overwriting your current work
• Export pages as PNG or PDF, share selected references, or export original files
• Move a complete project with Mica’s portable .refboard archive

Collect what inspires you. Study what matters. Keep creating.

stats.label: Platforms — iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro
Feature guides with steps, options and best practices
MCP tools so AI agents can build boards on Mac
Languages, with on-device AI and offline boards

highlights.title: Collect references, then make art
highlights.description: Pull images, GIFs, WebP animations, video, PDFs and SVGs onto an infinite Metal canvas. Boards hold pages and layers, so a project stays in one place instead of a folder of loose files.
bullets: Import from Photos, Files, the camera, the scanner or the clipboard
Share from any app straight to a board page, or to Capture Inbox
Drag and drop on iPad and Mac; one original per image, reused across boards

highlights.title: Design UI and layouts on the same canvas
highlights.description: Frames, Super Layout, components with variants, variables with modes and prototypes sit next to your references. Build an app screen, a poster or an App Store screenshot set without switching tools.
bullets: Super Layout: rows, columns and grid flow with Hug, Fill and min/max
Components, variants and library boards for design systems
Prototype links and clickable HTML export

highlights.title: Turn any flat layer into a 3D object
highlights.description: Make 3D extrudes or inflates a layer or group from its real outline, holes included. Pick a surface, light it, pose it and place the render on the board at the exact size you need.
bullets: Extrude or Inflate with depth, bevel and smoothing
Materials from glossy to glass and marble, with light and shadow presets
Edit 3D reopens the render with its saved settings

highlights.title: Import and render 3D models
highlights.description: Bring in USDZ, USD, OBJ, STL and more, pose and light the model, put your screenshots on device screens, and add a full-size render to the board.
bullets: Camera angles such as Angled Left and Isometric, lighting presets such as Studio and Golden Hour
Screen plates place images on a model’s screens without touching the bezel
Transparent or colored backgrounds and exact output sizes

highlights.title: Study color, value and motion
highlights.description: Generate palettes from the dominant colors in a reference, check values with grayscale and posterize, and step through GIFs and video frame by frame.
bullets: Six- or twelve-color palettes, or sample an exact area
Grayscale with 2, 3, 4 or 6 posterize levels, plus composition grids
Save video frames straight to the board

highlights.title: Rename layers with AI
highlights.description: Mica names layers from what they contain, on your device, with no account or network. Use it on one layer, a whole nested tree, or with your own naming style.
bullets: AI Nested Rename walks frames and groups
Choose a naming style that matches your team
Runs locally; nothing leaves your device

highlights.title: Draw, mark up and measure
highlights.description: Sketch over references, circle what matters, and measure proportions with Apple Pencil, a finger or a mouse. Annotations stay on the board, separate from the originals.
bullets: Annotate, highlight and erase over any reference
Brush tool with paint texture and brush styles
Finger panning while you draw with Pencil

highlights.title: Let AI agents build boards for you
highlights.description: On Mac, Mica runs a local MCP server. Connect Claude, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client and agents can read, create, edit and export boards with the same features you use, each call one undo step.
bullets: 45 tools covering items, effects, styles, variables, components and exports
Per-permission control, board scope and an Activity log
Local only: listens on 127.0.0.1 and never sees private boards

highlights.title: Put your boards in the room
highlights.description: Edit boards in a spatial workspace, pin reference boards to your walls, and open 3D references in a volume beside your work.
bullets: Boards in their own windows, two-hand transforms on the selection
Frame a room board to match the wall
Inspect references up close without borders
